# Decisions (sprint S21)

- D-t02 (t02-choose-api-version, planner): Build against API version v1 with base path AX-80684 and error format AX-55709. Relies on facts: style_guide.api_version = v1 (acme-docs/02_api_style_guide_v1.md), api.base_path = AX-80684 (repo/api.py base_path()), api.error_format = AX-55709 (repo/api.py error_format()). The recorded facts match the current repo/api.py, so no conflict to resolve.
- D-t02-v2 (t02-choose-api-version, planner): Adopt API version v2, superseding the earlier D-t02 choice of v1. Relies on fact: style_guide.api_version = v2 (acme-docs/06_api_style_guide_v2.md), which replaces v1 (acme-docs/02_api_style_guide_v1.md, withdrawn). The v2 style guide governs because v1 is withdrawn. Endpoint design from t03 was built on v1, so follow-up task t12-update-endpoints-for-v2 is added.
- D-t13 (t13-reuse-billing-cycle, planner): Reuse the Bolt Billing API billing cycle from S07 ("quarterly, invoiced on day 7") and the API-key header from S13 ("X-Core-Key"). Found in history/MEMORY.md (Bolt Billing API S07 billing_cycle; Acme Notes API S13 auth_method "API key in X-Core-Key header"); S13 decision s13-t05-choose-auth in history/decisions.jsonl. Code settings from repo/billing.py: billing.cycle = AX-14962, billing.currency = AX-86465. The key header stays consistent with D-t05 (API keys not for user traffic).
- D-t09 (t09-review-spec, researcher): REJECT the CRUD spec from t07 until it is rebuilt on API v2. Relies on facts: style_guide.api_version = v2 (acme-docs/06_api_style_guide_v2.md; v1 withdrawn, see D-t02-v2), security.auth_method = JWT bearer tokens, RS256 (D-t05), api.base_path = AX-80684, auth.token_ttl = AX-59344, db.engine = AX-28059 (all match current repo/). The spec states it is built against v1, which is withdrawn. Auth and settings are correct. Also api.error_format is now AX-41106 in repo/api.py, superseding the stale AX-55709. Next: fix the version statement and re-check against artifacts/t12-update-endpoints-for-v2/openapi-v2.md.
- D-t05 (t05-choose-auth, planner): User traffic uses JWT bearer tokens (RS256, Acme identity provider); the customer's long-lived X-Api-Key request is not adopted for user traffic. Relies on facts: security.auth_method = JWT bearer tokens, RS256 (acme-docs/04_security_note.md) and customer.requested_auth_method = long-lived API key in X-Api-Key (acme-docs/05_customer_request.md). The security note governs because a long-lived static key contradicts it; for Globex's non-interactive back-office scripts, we defer a separate, scoped, revocable service credential (e.g. machine-to-machine token exchange for short-lived JWTs) to security review, and tell the account team. Settings: auth.token_ttl = AX-59344 (repo/auth.py now; supersedes stale AX-87187 from t04, because the current code governs) and auth.key_header = AX-71613 (repo/auth.py, matches the recorded fact).
